messages:
anya (support): Hey team — customer report: /invoke returns 400 with schema validation errors for tool 'address-normalizer'. Payload accepted earlier but now fails after SDK v1.12.

samir (eng): can you paste the raw body and request_id?

anya (support): request_id: rQ8-23f7

support-bot: Logged request rQ8-23f7 to /var/log/requests/2026/03/...

anya (support): Raw body:
```json
{"tool":"address-normalizer","input":{"user":{"id":12345,"email":"joe@acme.com"},"address":"123 Main"}}
```

anya (support): API reply:
```json
{"error":"schema_validation_failed","details":[{"path":"/input/user/id","message":"type: string expected, integer found"},{"path":"/input","message":"additionalProperties not allowed: metadata"}]}
```

jordan (ml): looks like user.id used to be string in our schema. SDK may have coerced ints to strings before. Any change in client? Asked customer if they upgraded.

anya (support): customer confirms upgraded to mobile SDK 3.4.0 yesterday.

samir (eng): quick repro attempt: curl command
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tool":"address-normalizer","input":{"user":{"id":12345,"email":"joe@acme.com"},"address":"123 Main"}}'
```

samir (eng): got 400 same as customer. stack trace points to json-schema validator at validate()/utils

samir (eng): root cause: schema currently defines user.id as "type":"string". mobile SDK 3.4.0 started sending integers for numeric IDs. Also unexpected metadata field present in other requests causing additionalProperties error.

jordan (ml): proposed fixes:
- shortterm: update server to accept number OR string for user.id using "oneOf": [{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}]
- longterm: roll SDK fix to coerce id to string and add migration note

anya (support): Reproduction steps added to ticket TCK-8921 with request id and curl

samir (eng): patch to schema commit hash abc123, rolling out canary to staging now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service tools-runtime-canary at 2026-03-16T10:12:00Z

anya (support): customer notified of temporary workaround: cast id to string in request or downgrade SDK to 3.3.x. customer will apply string cast and confirm.

support-bot: customer confirmed workaround works, no more validation errors. :white_check_mark:

anya (support): followup: we should add a rule to our API docs about user.id accepted types and add a unit test to prevent regressions. created docs PR #562

samir (eng): will follow up with SDK team for patch to revert coercion behavior.

jordan (ml): adding a quick unit test to validation harness.

anya (support): closing thread when deploy is stable. Thanks all :pray:
